title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Service Operations Agent for conversational admin setup
summary: The briefing passes: the billing controls, prerequisites and documented capabilities are supported, and the roadmap facts match. Minor corrections concern checklist controls missing from the table and an additional source for the description of direct configuration changes.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; summary; Cost and licensing; Scope; controls[0].governs
claims.claim: The agent has a Power Platform pay-as-you-go prerequisite, supporting the consumption licensing model.
claims.quote: The Power Platform Pay-as-you-go plan requires the use of an Azure subscription that the system charges when the agent runs. Make sure that you set up consumption-based billing.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Why it matters; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The system charges an Azure subscription when the agent runs, supporting the variable cost rating.
claims.quote: The Power Platform Pay-as-you-go plan requires the use of an Azure subscription that the system charges when the agent runs.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The Use Service Operations Agent page names no licence among its prerequisites.
claims.quote: Searched: Service Operations Agent Conversational Setup credits; read Use Service Operations Agent, including its complete Prerequisites list: two roles, pay-as-you-go and Application Insights, without a named licence.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A rate or credit count specific to Conversational Setup is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: Service Operations Agent Conversational Setup credits; Service Operations Agent Conversational credits rate billing. Read Use Service Operations Agent, its FAQ, consumption billing and industry templates; the eight-credit figure is explicitly for industry-template setup.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Power Platform pay-as-you-go meters are billed to the billing plan's Power Platform account resource in the Azure subscription.
claims.quote: When a billing plan is created, a corresponding Power Platform account resource is created in the Azure subscription that's specified by the billing plan. All Azure meters for Power Platform products are billed to this resource.

claims.claim: The agent's Manage users tools can update user details.
claims.quote: Update | Modify user details (first/last name, email, title, phone, capacity).

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The agent can deactivate user accounts.
claims.quote: Disable | Deactivate a user account.

claims.quote: ListUsers | List all queue members with their name and email.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: The checked documentation does not state where Service Operations Agent prompt and configuration context is processed or stored.
claims.quote: Searched: Service Operations Agent data stored processing; Service Operations Agent data processing storage audit connection identity. Read Use Service Operations Agent, its overview and responsible AI FAQ; no processing or storage location is stated for this agent.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: The agent's Learn pages do not identify the account under which its MCP connection executes changes.
claims.quote: Searched: Service Operations Agent MCP identity audit; Service Operations Agent data processing storage audit connection identity. Read Use Service Operations Agent, its overview and responsible AI FAQ; they describe connection consent, not its execution identity.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: The agent's Learn pages do not describe how changes made by chat are recorded for auditing.
claims.quote: Searched: Service Operations Agent MCP identity audit; Service Operations Agent data processing storage audit connection identity. Read Use Service Operations Agent, its overview and responsible AI FAQ; no audit trail for its configuration changes is described.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft describes conversational setup as keeping a human in the loop.
claims.quote: Use natural language to set up your contact center and watch Service Operations Agent run the steps while keeping a human in the loop.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The agent may present draft actions for administrator review and confirmation.
claims.quote: Depending on the scenario, it may also retrieve relevant configuration information, guide users through multi-step tasks, or present draft actions for administrator review and confirmation.

claims.claim: The agent is not designed to operate as an autonomous system.
claims.quote: It supports administrators within the product experience and isn't designed to replace administrator judgment or operate as an autonomous system.

claims.claim: Multistep setup and troubleshooting showed greater variability in testing and might require clarification.
claims.quote: Results indicated stronger performance on information retrieval and grounded knowledge tasks, while multistep setup and troubleshooting scenarios showed more variability and might require additional clarification or confirmation.

claims.claim: Ambiguous prompts can lead to incomplete or incorrect results.
claims.quote: Service Operations Agent might provide incomplete guidance, request clarification, or return incorrect or partial results when prompts are ambiguous, configuration metadata is missing or out of date, or a scenario isn't fully supported by the underlying platform tools and APIs.

claims.claim: The workstream and queue must be for the same channel.
claims.quote: Make sure that the workstream and queue are for the same channel.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Scope: Prerequisites; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Application Insights must be configured for the agent to troubleshoot issues during setup.
claims.quote:
For Service Operations Agent to troubleshoot issues during setup:
- Application Insights is configured.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Scope: Prerequisites; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Application Insights must be connected to Dynamics 365 Contact Center for setup troubleshooting.
claims.quote:
For Service Operations Agent to troubleshoot issues during setup:
- Application Insights is connected with Dynamics 365 Contact Center.

claims.claim: Pay-as-you-go setup links an active Azure subscription to a Power Platform environment.
claims.quote: To set up pay-as-you-go billing, you first need an active Azure subscription. Then, you link the subscription to your Power Platform environment using the Power Platform admin center or within Power Apps.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft directs pay-as-you-go administrators to Microsoft Cost Management in the Azure portal to view usage and adjust budgets.
claims.quote: For pay-as-you-go, use Microsoft Cost Management in the Azure portal to view detailed usage and adjust spending limits (budgets) to free up more capacity.

claims.claim: Pay-as-you-go is available for production and sandbox environments.
claims.quote: Pay-as-you-go is available for production and sandbox environments.

claims.claim: Connected Application Insights resources can incur Azure data ingestion and retention charges.
claims.quote: Because workspace-based Application Insights resources store their data in a Log Analytics workspace, the billing for data ingestion and retention is done by the workspace where the Application Insights data is located.

claims.claim: The linked Dynamics 365 consumption-billing guidance permits prepaid capacity and pay-as-you-go on the same environment.
claims.quote: Both billing models can be used on the Dynamics 365 environment.

claims.claim: That consumption-billing guidance says prepaid capacity is consumed first.
claims.quote: Prepaid capacity is consumed first.

claims.claim: The Use Service Operations Agent page applies to Dynamics 365 Contact Center only.
claims.quote: Applies to: Dynamics 365 Contact Center only

claims.claim: The Use Service Operations Agent page does not mark Conversational Setup as preview.
claims.quote: Searched: Service Operations Agent Dynamics 365 Contact Center conversational setup. Read the entire Use Service Operations Agent page: no preview designation for Conversational Setup; its related industry-template page is explicitly preview.

claims.claim: Copilot Service admin center's Contact Center Agents page lists Service Operations Agent alongside Customer Assist Agent and Quality Assurance Agent.
claims.quote: In the site map of Copilot Service admin center, select Contact Center Agents. The Contact Center Agents page appears where you can view and manage the AI agents for your contact center.

claims.claim: The billing-plan path and accompanying wizard-field note lead to selection of the environment for pay-as-you-go billing.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Licensing. In the Licensing pane, select Pay-as-you-go plans. The Billing plans page is displayed. Select New billing plan. The New billing plan pane is displayed. Select Azure subscription.

claims.claim: pac licensing add-billing-policy-environment links environments using --billing-policy-id and --environment-ids supplied as a JSON array.
claims.quote:
pac licensing add-billing-policy-environment
(Preview) Link billing policy ID with environments.
--billing-policy-id: The billing policy ID.
--environment-ids: Provide the value as a JSON array.

claims.claim: The linking command is preview-labelled and does not create the billing policy.
claims.quote:
pac licensing add-billing-policy-environment | (Preview) Link billing policy ID with environments.
pac licensing create-billing-policy | (Preview) Creates the billing policy at tenant level.

claims.where: controls[1].ui and controls[1].api; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: No tenant or environment UI switch or API to turn Service Operations Agent off is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Service Operations Agent disable turn off admin switch API; Service Operations Agent remove billing plan connection disable. Read Use Service Operations Agent, its overview and responsible AI FAQ; these document prerequisites, not a feature-off setting or operation.

claims.claim: Dataverse security-role assignment governs users' access to data and resources.
claims.quote: To control who can access restricted or sensitive data and resources and what they can do with them, assign users to security roles.

claims.claim: The MCP connection is located in Power Apps by selecting the environment, then Connections and D365 Contact Center MCP Connection.
claims.quote:
Go to Power Apps.
Select the correct environment in the upper-right corner.
Select Connections in the left pane.
Locate D365 Contact Center MCP Connection, and then delete it.

claims.where: Governance controls; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Learn describes deleting the MCP connection and recreating it through a new Admin Copilot conversation to refresh it.
claims.quote:
Locate D365 Contact Center MCP Connection, and then delete it.
In Copilot Service admin center, open Admin Copilot, and then start a new conversation.
When the connection card appears, select Allow to create a new connection for D365 Contact Center Admin MCP.

claims.claim: The connection-refresh instructions are not presented as a way to block the agent.
claims.quote: Searched: Service Operations Agent remove billing plan connection disable. Read Use Service Operations Agent: the connection procedure is introduced as configuring or refreshing the connection when actions or information retrieval fail, not as disabling the agent.

claims.claim: Removing an environment from its billing policy stops further pay-as-you-go charges for that environment.
claims.quote: Any usage that was already incurred up to this point is billed to your Azure subscription, but no further usage is charged.

claims.claim: The consumption-billing page does not describe what removing the billing plan does to Service Operations Agent.
claims.quote: Searched: Service Operations Agent remove billing plan connection disable. Read Manage consumption-based billing and capacity and Set up pay-as-you-go; neither states the agent-specific outcome of unlinking its environment.

claims.claim: Environment admins, Power Platform admins, Global admins and Dynamics 365 admins can create billing policies, subject to the role table's scope restrictions.
claims.quote: Environment admin | Yes | Yes, for billing policies the admin created. | Yes, for billing policies the admin created and for environments in which they're admins.

claims.claim: The Service Operations Agent page does not say whether Customer Assist Agent or Quality Assurance Agent shares its meter or prerequisites.
claims.quote: Searched: Service Operations Agent Customer Assist Quality Assurance billing prerequisites. Read the entire Use Service Operations Agent page and Contact center agents overview; the former's prerequisites do not specify shared billing or prerequisites for the other agents.

claims.claim: Microsoft's responsible AI FAQ recommends verifying configuration outcomes and maintaining review and verification particularly in production.
claims.quote: Organizations should maintain review and verification steps for setup and configuration changes, particularly in production environments, and use manual administration paths when the system indicates uncertainty or when a scenario falls outside supported workflows.

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Learn advises clear, detailed prompts specifying the relevant channel or topic, and illustrates prompts naming workstreams and queues.
claims.quote: Use clear, detailed prompts, and explicitly specify the relevant channel or topic to reduce the risk of inaccurate or unreliable answers.

claims.claim: The governance checklist names role assignments, Application Insights, the MCP connection and Cost Management budgets, but the table does not represent these controls.
claims.quote: Identify who holds the Omnichannel administrator and System Administrator roles; Connect Application Insights; Review usage and budgets; Recheck the role holders and the connection. Table: billing-plan membership and an undocumented feature-off switch only.
claims.fix: Add after the table: 'The checklist also covers role assignments, the Application Insights connection, the MCP connection and Microsoft Cost Management budgets; those controls are not represented in this table.' Do not add control rows in this correction.

claims.claim: Conversational setup can create and update configuration without navigating each individual setup page.
claims.quote: Create and update configuration artifacts without navigating multiple pages
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/contact-center/administer/overview-service-operations-agent to sources as 'Overview of Service Operations Agent in Dynamics 365 Contact Center'.
